roles.student: Public learning plus provisioned read-only linked learner portal
roles.parent: Student-controlled local summary plus provisioned read-only approved learner link
roles.teacher: Public tools plus assigned-batch read and attendance insertion
roles.owner: Verified owner pilot, own synthetic institute only
roles.financeStaff: Provisioned read-only fees and learner codes
roles.platformAdmin: Provisioned commercial reviewer and/or independently provisioned marketplace moderator, no global learner access

features.purpose: Responsive navigation, public site, privacy and legacy route recovery
features.flow: Navigation → route → rendered page or explicit unavailable state
features.positive: All registered pages open; mobile menu works
features.integration: Course and studio navigation, legacy redirects
features.security: No secret-bearing data or privileged navigation; response headers
features.performance: No horizontal overflow; no uncaught errors

features.purpose: Find lessons, understand concepts and record local practice evidence
features.flow: Search → course → answer → validation → local progress → student summary
features.negative: Wrong answer is not recorded; unknown lesson rejected
features.integration: Courses, roadmap, project studio, family summary
features.security: Local data only; no identity or verified mastery claim
features.performance: No API polling for local learning

features.flow: GET questions → select answers → POST → scoring → feedback and courses
features.positive: Valid answers yield score and related links in three languages
features.negative: Incomplete answers or old version rejected
features.integration: Diagnostic, course routes and learner summary
features.security: No answer key in GET; no profile collection
features.performance: One initial GET, one submission POST

features.purpose: Safe interactive interdisciplinary and money experiments
features.flow: Inputs → bounded calculation → displayed results → optional server verification
features.negative: Invalid ranges, zero divisors and stale verification
features.security: No real payments or equipment operation
features.performance: Local sliders do not send API requests

features.purpose: Practice-paper draft, brand preview and indicative coaching price
features.flow: Select options → validated local or server model → draft or estimate
features.positive: Paper and brand update; price estimate matches
features.negative: Invalid plan/topic rejected; no publishing or payment
features.integration: Coaching landing and learning question bank
features.performance: Local drafts do not call database

features.purpose: Authenticated synthetic institute records, admissions, batches, attendance and fees
features.flow: Sign in → browser form → session API → tenant API → Postgres/RLS → persisted row → updated UI
features.positive: Owner creates and updates own records, receipts match invoice
features.negative: Invalid records, duplicate receipt, stale update, wrong owner and cross-tenant FK denied
features.integration: Admissions, learners, attendance, invoices, receipts and summary
features.security: Actual disposable Supabase Auth and PostgreSQL in CI; direct Data API isolation, no production access
features.performance: Bounded queries, no polling, private no-store

features.purpose: Safe bounded request and response contracts and process health
features.flow: Request → content-type and bounded JSON validation → handler → no-store response
features.negative: Oversized or invalid JSON rejected; internal errors hidden
features.security: No secrets in errors; no-store; origin check for mutations
features.performance: Bounded request body and response latency

features.purpose: India-first foundational and emerging technology practice in English Hindi Hinglish
features.flow: Choose language → read scenario → answer → feedback → local practice check → suggested next skill
features.positive: Correct answer advances checks and next skill; language preserves selected options
features.negative: Wrong answer does not count; duplicate and invalid IDs rejected
features.integration: Home, navigation, existing courses and future labs
features.security: No identity, external AI call, bank details or real payments; local practice only
features.performance: No API calls from scenario practice

features.purpose: Revocable role-scoped member dashboards for institute staff and linked learners and assigned teacher attendance entry
features.flow: Verified sign-in → active membership → selected institute → bounded RLS queries → read-only portal
features.positive: Approved membership sees only assigned records and permitted categories
features.negative: Revoked member, foreign tenant, direct insert and privilege escalation denied; unassigned attendance write denied
features.integration: Existing owner workspace and Auth session
features.security: RLS uses active membership and composite FKs; approved links; no public role assignment; no production test records
features.performance: Bounded 100 recent rows per category, no polling

features.purpose: Immutable indicative subscription quotes and restricted platform review
features.flow: Verified owner → server plan version → immutable DB quote → reviewer decision → history
features.positive: Correct quote amount and idempotency; one approval or rejection
features.negative: Client price tampering, foreign quote read, duplicate review and nonreviewer approval rejected
features.integration: Existing owner and member sessions, plan pricing, coaching landing
features.security: No payments; RLS and least privilege; separate reviewer, no learner access; manual UPI instructions restricted to approved owner; immutable bank verification records, no automatic activation
features.performance: Bounded latest 100 quotes and one batched review lookup

features.purpose: Private invite-only practice sync with explicit opt-in and revision checks
features.flow: Local checks → explicit sync → validated union → RLS persisted → restore or clear
features.positive: Merge different device checks; read persisted cloud history
features.negative: Unprovisioned account and stale deletion denied
features.security: Private self-only rows; self-reported practice, not grades; no real minor data in pilot

features.purpose: Independent moderation and public coaching directory
features.flow: Owner submits → moderator checks → publish → public read → withdraw
features.negative: Owner approval, missing verification and unpublished public read denied
features.integration: Control center, commercial review and coaching landing
features.security: Separate provisioned moderator; no learner access; public columns only
